question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class WebChat shortcut or prompt-snippet browser, and which surface should own shortcut definitions and storage?
rationale: The request is useful UI ergonomics, but it adds product surface, config/storage, and possibly plugin or command metadata contracts that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Design shared shortcut metadata first
options.body: Create or extend a maintained command, skill, or plugin metadata contract so the UI browser is backed by one canonical owner instead of a WebChat-only config file.

options.title: Keep shortcuts browser-local
options.body: Implement a Control UI-local shortcut list with import/export or local profile storage, avoiding gateway config but limiting cross-device sharing.

options.title: Defer to plugin UI panels
options.body: Hold this request until the generic Control UI plugin-panel direction is settled, then make shortcuts a plugin or bundle surface.

recommendation.title: Design shared shortcut metadata first
recommendation.body: Create or extend a maintained command, skill, or plugin metadata contract so the UI browser is backed by one canonical owner instead of a WebChat-only config file.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-cutting Control UI, config/storage, and product-surface decision, and steipete is the strongest routing signal from current maintainer guidance and recent UI history.
